job.text: Which regions' donations rose most after the ad blitz?

insight.important: North's donations rose most, by 41 %, although South gained the most dollars

title.text: North Rose Most After the Ad Blitz; South Gained the Most Dollars
title.descriptive: Donations by Region Before and After the Ad Blitz, Q1 and Q2 2022

source.shows: the change between two periods as an arrow chart: the values before and after in dollars beside the change in %, sharing the rows (G1.47); rows by the value before, largest first (D-40); green for a rise and red for a fall, since more donations are better (G7.22); the key over the ends of one arrow. The book names the periods only before and after the blitz; the quarters are ours
the book's most common version, clustered bars of the two periods: refused, since they show the values side by side with nothing to suggest change and no change in % (R6-14, G1.47)
the dollar panel alone: refused, since shown only absolute changes most readers name South, not North, as the most improved (G1.47)

overrides.reason: the book's version with the dollar panel alone, rebuilt for comparison (s. 0187)

source.shows: the dollar panel alone, drawn through an override, as the book shows it before adding the % panel: South's long arrow looks like the biggest improvement
the same arrows when the change itself is the message: rows by the change in %, largest first (D-40)
